findings.title: Background reader thread in createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti is never joined
findings.body: In `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti`, the thread started on line 139 to concurrently call `managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(...)` is never joined before asserting `assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty())` and returning from the test. When `deletedAll.set(true)` is called on line 155, an HTTP request on the reader thread is likely still in flight: if that call throws an exception, it will be added to `caughtExceptions` after the assertion on line 157 has already passed, masking a test failure. Additionally, the unjoined thread can still be running while subsequent tests in `GroupTest` execute against the shared `managedRealm`. Join the reader thread after `deletedAll.set(true)` and before asserting on `caughtExceptions`.
